d:
Hello everyone!

My name is Guts26, and I am excited to introduce my very first comic project: "Corruption of the White Witch".

I am an indie creator, not a professional artist, and creating comics is a passion hobby I have loved for many years. This project is currently a Work in Progress, and I am working hard behind the scenes to bring each page to life.

Release Strategy & Early Access

The comic is published here on E-Hentai und Pixiv for free and Pixiv FANBOX for Supporters:

*Public Release (Free on E-Hentai and Pixiv):All main pages will eventually be released publicly for free on Pixiv. No content will be permanently locked behind a paywall! Everyone will be able to read the entire story as it gets published.
*Supporter Early Access (Pixiv FANBOX): For those who enjoy my work and would like to support my artistic journey, members on FANBOX get to read new pages 4 to 8 weeks ahead of the public release and direct digital downloads.

Where to Find the Comic

Pixiv:
https://www.pixiv.net/user/116281849/series/346462

Pixiv FANBOX:
https://guts26comics.fanbox.cc

I don't want to spoil too much of the story here—dive in and read it for yourself! I would love to hear your feedback, thoughts, and impressions as the story unfolds.

Thank you so much for your support!

Yours,
Guts26
